description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1536/18 of 13.02.2018, Homagama D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically an amendment to the Registration of Title Act regarding a specific parcel of land (No. 88 of Block 08) in Colombo District. It involves updating land title records with encumbrance details (right of way), which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
